title: DANA CORPORATION: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT (919 affected)
summary: THE OFFSET TOE ADJUSTING PIN CAN FRACTURE UNDER CONDITIONS SUCH AS TORSIONAL LOADS, FLEXING MOTION, IMPACT LOADS, AND OVERTORQUING.

title: HOLLAND HITCH COMPANY: STRUCTURE:FIFTH WHEEL ASSEMBLY (4,918 affected)
summary: A DEFECT IN THE FRONT LOCK PORTION OF THE FIFTH WHEEL CASTING (A STRUCTURAL, LOAD BEARING COMPONENT OF THE FIFTH WHEEL ASSEMBLY) CAUSES A CRACK IN THE CASTING. THIS CRACK CAN PROPAGATE OVER TIME.

title: DYGERT SEATING, INC.: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEATS (12,000 affected)
summary: THE ROUND STEEL TUBING USED TO MANUFACTURE THE SEATBACK CAN CONTAIN AN INAPPROPRIATE GRADE OF STEEL OR DEFECTIVE STEEL. THIS CAN CAUSE THE SEATBACK TO BEND, WARP, TWIST BACKWARDS, AND TO EVENTUALLY BREAK, CAUSING THE SEATBACK TO FAIL.

title: Medtec Ambulance Corporation: STRUCTURE:DOOR ASSEMBLY (13 affected)
summary: THE OUTSIDE LATCH OF THE TRIMARK REAR DOORS DOES NOT WORK IN UNISON WITH THE STRIKER, CAUSING THE RODS OF THE DOORS TO BIND. THIS BINDING CAUSED THE STRIKER PADDLE TO BREAK, AND THE DOORS TO NOT COMPLETELY LATCH SHUT.

title: Hyundai Motor America: HEATER:WATER:DEFROSTER:DEFOGGER:HEATER CORE:WATER (270,000 affected)
summary: THE HEATER CONTROL VALVE STEM DOES NOT MEET THE MATERIAL SPECIFICATIONS. HIGH COOLANT TEMPERATURES CAN CAUSE THE STEM TO LEAK.

title: Oshkosh Corporation: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL (864 affected)
summary: A THROTTLE CONTROL CABLE WITH AN INNER "STEEL SHIELDED" COMPONENT WAS SUBSTITUTED FOR A CABLE WITH AN INNER "STEEL STRANDED" COMPONENT IN A DESIGN WHICH REQUIRES A MINIMUM BEND RADIUS OF 4 INCHES. THE INNER "STEEL SHIELDED" CABLE HAS A MINIMUM BEND RADIUS OF 8 INCHES, AND CAN BIND OR BREAK IN ITS CURRENT USE IN THE THROTTLE ASSEMBLY.

title: FLEETWOOD ENTERPRISES, INC.: FUEL:LPG LINES:(PIPES) METALLIC (131 affected)
summary: THE LIQUID PROPANE GAS (LPG) PIPES AT THE REAR OF THE VEHICLE ARE ROUTED SO THEY CONTACT THE TAG AXLE DURING VERTICAL MOVEMENT. THIS CONTACT CAN RUPTURE THE LPG PIPE AND ALLOW LPG LEAKAGE.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): FUEL:FUEL PUMP (230,000 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MULTIPURPOSE PASSENGER VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH PLASTIC FUEL TANKS.   THE FUEL TANK SENDING UNIT GASKET CAN CRACK CAUSING FUEL AND FUEL VAPOR LEAKS.

title: SAAB CARS USA, INC.: LIGHTING:SWITCH:BUTTON:RING:BRAKE LIGHTS (9,747 affected)
summary: A NUMBER OF BRAKE LIGHT SWITCHES HAVE AN OVAL-SHAPED PISTON WHICH CAN GET STUCK UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS. OTHER SWITCHES WERE MOUNTED SO THAT BOTH LOCKING TABS ARE NOT COMPLETELY ENGAGED IN THE MOUNTING BRACKET. IF ONE SIDE IS NOT ENGAGED, THE SWITCH IS MISALIGNED WITH THE PEDAL MECHANISM AND CAN BIND THE PISTON MOVEMENT, WHICH CAN CAUSE THE BRAKE LIGHT SWITCH TO STICK IN THE "OFF" OR "ON" POSITION.

title: HOLIDAY RAMBLER CORP.: FURNACE:RECREATIONAL VEHICLE (11 affected)
summary: AN INCOMPLETE SEAL AT THE REAR OF THE MOTORHOME BETWEEN THE LIVING FACILITY AREA AND THE COMPARTMENT WHICH CONTAINS THE HEATING SYSTEM CAN ALLOW CARBON MONOXIDE (CO) TO ENTER THE LIVING AREA.

title: Oshkosh Corporation: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:AIR SUPPLY SYSTEM (37 affected)
summary: THE AIR COMPRESSOR AIR SUPPLY LINE IS ROUTED FROM THE COMPRESSOR OVER THE TOP OF THE FRAME RAIL, UNDER THE BRAKE HYDROMAX, AND DOWN TO THE AIR SYSTEM. THIS LINE CAN CONTACT THE STEEL SECTION OF THE HYDROMAX HYDRAULIC SUPPLY LINE, CAUSING A LEAK TO OCCUR IN THE HYDRAULIC LINE, ALLOWING HYDRAULIC FLUID TO LEAK ON THE LEFT FRONT WHEEL AND BRAKE ASSEMBLY.

title: SAAB CARS USA, INC.: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEATS (3,252 affected)
summary: A WELD IN THE SEAT RAILS WAS NOT MADE, INCREASING THE RISK OF FATIGUE CRACKS FORMING AROUND THE ATTACHMENT BUSHINGS ON THE HEIGHT ADJUSTMENT MECHANISM, CAUSING THE POSSIBILITY OF THE HEIGHT ADJUSTER BREAKING IN A REAR END COLLISION AND ALLOWING THE SEAT TO FOLD BACKWARDS.

title: Ford Motor Company: FUEL:FUEL LINES:HOSES:NON-METALLIC (11,400 affected)
summary: THE FRONT FUEL LINES HAVE A SECTION OF FLEXIBLE HOSE THAT IS SUSCEPTIBLE TO CRACKING WHICH CAN ALLOW FUEL LEAKAGE.

title: Mazda North American Operations: FUEL:FUEL LINES:HOSES:NON-METALLIC (1,868 affected)
summary: THE FRONT FUEL LINES HAVE A SECTION OF FLEXIBLE HOSE THAT IS SUSCEPTIBLE TO CRACKING WHICH CAN ALLOW FUEL LEAKAGE.

title: WAYNE WHEELED VEHICLES: EXHAUST SYSTEM (13 affected)
summary: INSUFFICIENT TORQUING OF BOLTS ON THE CLAMPS USED TO SECURE ADJOINING SECTIONS OF THE EXHAUST SYSTEM CAN CAUSE THE SECTIONS TO SEPARATE FROM THE CLAMPS, AND CAN ALLOW EXHAUST GAS TO LEAK UNDER THE VEHICLE.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): FUEL:FUEL SYSTEMS (7,000 affected)
summary: THESE VEHICLES DO NOT MEET THE REAR IMPACT TEST REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 301, "FUEL SYSTEM INTEGRITY."

title: General Motors, LLC: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:TRAILER HITCHES AND ATTACHM (740 affected)
summary: THE TRAILER HITCH ATTACHING BOLTS WERE NOT TIGHTENED TO THE SPECIFIED TORQUE. THIS CAN LEAD TO LOOSENING AND SUBSEQUENT BREAKAGE OF THE FASTENERS.

title: DORSEY CORPORATION: STRUCTURE:FRAME:MEMBERS AND BODY (664 affected)
summary: AN INADEQUATE WELD IN THE ATTACHMENT OF THE STEEL FLOOR CROSSMEMBERS TO THE ALUMINUM BODY BORDER CAN CRACK UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS AND RESULT IN A LACK OF LATERAL SUPPORT TO CARGO LOADED ON THE TRAILER.

title: General Motors, LLC: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT SPINDLE:KNUCKLE:STEER (65 affected)
summary: THESE VEHICLES WERE BUILT WITH OVERTORQUED DRIVE AXLE SPINDLE NUTS. THIS CONDITION CAN CAUSE EXCESSIVE LOADS ON THE SPINDLE NUT AND DRIVE AXLE RESULTING IN FAILURE OF THE DRIVE AXLE OR THE SPINDLE NUT. FAILURE OF EITHER OF THESE COMPONENTS CAN RESULT IN SEPARATION OF THE STEERING KNUCKLE TIRE-WHEEL ASSEMBLY FROM THE DRIVE AXLE.

title: General Motors, LLC: EQUIPMENT:OWNERS MANUAL INFORMATION (6,315 affected)
summary: THESE VEHICLES WERE SHIPPED WITH THE WRONG OWNER'S MANUAL, AND, THEREFORE, THE CORRECT INFORMATION REGARDING SAFETY BELT USAGE IS NOT AVAILABLE TO THE OWNER. THIS DOES NOT CONFORM WITH FMVSS NO. 209, "SEAT BELT ASSEMBLIES."

title: Ford Motor Company: STEERING:GEAR:RACK AND PINION (12,700 affected)
summary: THE STEERING GEARS HAVE AN IMPROPERLY MACHINED SNAP RING GROOVE. THIS CAN CAUSE A FRACTURE OF THE SNAP RING WITH SUBSEQUENT DAMAGE TO THE RECIRCULATING BALL GUIDE TUBE. ALSO, THE O-RING SEAL IN VEHICLES BUILT AFTER FEBRUARY 1988 DOES NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS AND IS INADEQUATE, CAUSING INTERIOR LEAKAGE AROUND THE O-RING / GLIDE RING SEAL IN THE STEERING GEAR.

title: THOMAS BUILT BUSES, INC.: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:ALTERNATOR:REGULATOR:STARTER (285 affected)
summary: A CABLE INSTALLED TO TEMPORARILY BYPASS THE NEUTRAL SWITCH TO ENABLE THE ENGINE TO BE STARTED WAS NOT REMOVED AT DELIVERY.  THE CABLE ALLOWS THE BUS TO BE STARTED WHILE IN A FORWARD OR REVERSE DRIVE GEAR.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: SUSPENSION:MOTORCYCLE FRONT (716 affected)
summary: CERTAIN SUSPENSION COMPONENTS CAN LOOSEN WHEN THE MOTORCYCLE IS RIDDEN HARD IN ROUGH OFF-ROAD CONDITIONS. THE RIGHT-HAND BEARING PIN IN THE REAR SWINGING ARM AND ALSO THE LOWER FLANGE NUT ON THE FRONT STRUT CAN BOTH LOOSEN.
